sentences.en: I copied a passage from the book into my notebook.
sentences.zh: 我把书中的一段话抄在了我的笔记本上。

sentences.en: I borrowed the notebook PC from the junior staff member.
sentences.zh: 我从初级职员那里借了一台笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: Preserved in his laboratory were more than a thousand notebooks.
sentences.zh: 在他的实验室里保存着上千本笔记本。

senses.zh: 笔记簿,笔记本电脑,手册,笔记本
